procedure.method: Independent fresh review without spawning, resuming or forking. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rubric, review rules, compact addendum and method/adapter. Verified exact input bytes and PNG headers; read all five listed native-evidence manifests without opening their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts, so both receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected, through tools.view_image with detail original and functions image output, M1 native then usage720 then thumbnail320, followed by M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same three-view order. These fifteen actual successful opens were all completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. Subsequently read the retained native/usage images for each member and each copy entry in packet order. No OCR, replacement assets, crops, image changes or additional image opens/revisits were used. Successful pin checks were not treated as semantic viewing. Session identity is unobservable here and is left null. Usage views are 720x405 for M1/M2 and 720x1080 for M3/M4/M5; thumbnails are 320x180 and 213x320 respectively, with aspect preserved to integer raster rounding and no upsampling.

diagonal light wedge, black grate and stippled paving

Severe black/cream/teal reduction, granular chipped marks, emphatic grate slots and a downward pavement crop produce a rough print-like, almost abstract street-detail identity. thumbnail320
title and upper-left copy relative to M1/M3/M4

Four members share a serif-related Korean title voice and broadly left-set copy, while M2 is emphatically gothic. residuals: M1, M3, M4 and M5 share left-set serif-related titles and an architectural/pavement vocabulary; the differentiation is strong but not maximally expansive in typographic voice.

M3 and M5 both inspect weathered curb/doorway surfaces. Their fine pale drawing versus coarse high-contrast print treatment, crop and light organization are distinct, though the underlying subject family remains close.
This is one craft critic's independent full-set judgment of the five selected members, not an aggregation of three critics or evidence about other stages or unseen requests.
